quest-log

~ Research ~

  1. IJCLab

    Jun–Jul 2026

    Research intern · with Chloé Hebborn & Patrick McGlynn

    Scattering solvers (R-matrix, DBMM) and reduced-basis and machine-learning emulators for nuclear reactions, benchmarked for large parameter-space exploration. The project →

  2. CEREMADE

    Sep 2024–Jan 2025

    Visiting research student · with Pierre Cardaliaguet

    Mean-field games applied to economics: how monetary shocks propagate in a general-equilibrium economy with sticky prices, through coupled Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman and Fokker–Planck equations.

  3. Sciences Po Paris

    Jun–Aug 2023

    Research assistant · with Julia Cagé

    Media ownership and content bias: built a large dataset of French television broadcasts for the study.

~ Projects ~

Computational emulation of nuclear dynamics

2026

M1 internship · IJCLab

A coupled-channel scattering solver and two emulators (RBM, LROM) that reproduce it within 0.5 % at a fraction of its cost, to make uncertainty quantification on optical potentials affordable.

  • [page]
  • [report PDF]
  • [code]

Urban morphogenesis

Jan 2026

With Raphael Raynaud · Université Paris Cité

An agent-based city grown from Schelling segregation and diffusion-limited aggregation, and the fractal dimension of what it builds.

  • [page & live DLA]

Self-gravitating N-body systems

Feb 2024

With Lionel Foret · Sorbonne Université

Direct-integration simulation of gravitating bodies and of the collective behaviour that long-range forces produce.
